subject: ela
intro: Pick the tool, skill, or step.

items.prompt:
Typing words on a computer uses the:
A) keyboard
B) window
C) wall

steps: Keys type letters. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A spell-checker helps you find:
A) spelling mistakes
B) the weather
C) the author

To make a paper copy, you:
A) print
B) sleep
C) run

steps: Printing makes a copy. Key is A.

items.prompt:
To write a report WITH a classmate online at the same time, you:
A) share the document
B) delete it
C) hide it

steps: Sharing enables collaboration. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Typing quickly and correctly is called:
A) keyboarding
B) coloring
C) napping

Before you close your file, you should:
A) save it
B) erase it
C) hide it

steps: Save to keep it. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Good keyboarding skills help a fourth grader:
A) type at least a page in a single sitting
B) run faster
C) draw better
items.answer: A) type at least a page in a single sitting

steps: Grade 4 typing goal. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) type at least a page in a single sitting

items.prompt:
Two students leave COMMENTS on each other's shared report. This is an example of:
A) collaborating with technology
B) printing
C) spell-checking

steps: Working together online. Key is A.
